verdict.reasons: Core defect: The Persian text 'آبگسترفراپارسیان' on the carton label is missing spaces between words, deviating from the authorized caption 'آبگستر فراپارسیان'. In high-resolution crop views, this text error is clearly visible and constitutes a branding defect. Minor advisory issues include a very tight gap between the product and the drip laterals, which falls under the permitted tolerance. The geometry, scene elements, and watermark are correct.

focused_physical_review.reason: The white-and-blue AFP package rests on the soil with a visible, uninterrupted gap around its complete footprint. The black irrigation line runs parallel on the right but does not touch, emerge from, or disappear behind the package base. No additional loose coils are visible, and there are no protruding strips, ribbons, or tape tails emerging from the carton sides or base.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
